Faq.title: Before we begin
Faq.description: A few answers about getting started and working together. Have something else in mind? Let’s talk.

start.question: How do I start a project with you?
start.answer: Send us your idea on WhatsApp, even if it is just a couple of lines. We will discuss what you need and work out the next step together.

platforms.question: Do you build websites and apps?
platforms.answer: Yes. We develop websites, web and mobile apps, desktop software, games, and database solutions. The right approach depends on what your project needs.

existing.question: Can you improve an existing project?
existing.answer: We can discuss improvements or new features. First, we need to review the current project and its technology to understand what is possible.

prepare.question: What should I prepare before we talk?
prepare.answer: A short description, who the project is for, and what it should do. Examples you like or a target date are helpful too. You do not need every detail figured out.

cost.question: How much will it cost, and how long will it take?
cost.answer: That depends on the scope and features. Once we understand the details, we agree on the work, cost, and timeline before development begins.

Contact.title: What’s on your mind?

Contact.reassurance: You don’t need a complete plan. Tell us what you need, and we’ll figure out the next step together.
